name: @custar/learner-core
description: Local-first engine for the CUSTAR learner app: SQLite store, outbox sync, lesson packs, mastery and the grown-up PIN gate. Pure TypeScript; platform pieces are injected through ports. Exports: '.' (engine), './fakes' (platform-neutral in-memory fakes, usable in the app's demo mode), './testing' (Node-only test helpers).
